page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, page number at the left. Title block centred: ornament, "DE", the title of the part in large capitals, "Pars III.", and an italic subtitle. Then the body text in one column, beginning with a large initial, with the last word broken at the line end and continued at the right.

main_text.l: quirit, de illis ut agatur, quæ
& harum vsus esse magnus solet: cùm, aut
rum exprobramus obliuionē: aut de in-digna

page.notes: The large initial "I" is a decorative woodcut letter, joined to "NDICATIS". The word "eafdē" has a tilde over the e. "obliuionē" has a tilde over the final e. The long s is printed as s and has been normalised to s. The text runs on to the next page at the right ("digna" is the continuation of "indigna").
